note: Captured by scripts/capture-playoffstatus-fixtures.ts. The four pages were stamped in two batches on the site itself: SEC and Big 12 said 'Sat Sep 26 11:30 pm', Big Ten and ACC said 'Sun Sep 27 2:45 am'. Both were 'Week 5 of 13'. That disagreement is why ConferenceOddsDocument carries a stamp per page and only reports a document-level one when all four agree.

entries.name: conference-map
entries.note: Not a playoffstatus payload. ESPN's conference map, exactly as getConferences() returns it, captured the same day so the two-way join can be asserted against real membership. 11 conferences, 138 teams; the power four are ACC 17, Big 12 16, Big Ten 18, SEC 16 — which is the 67 rows the four pages carry.
